parts.description: Create and deploy Power Pages code sites (SPA frameworks: React, Vue, Angular, Astro). Dataverse + Web API integration, table permissions, server logic, cloud flows, SEO, auth.
parts.downstream_target: Power Pages site (deployed via `pac pages upload-code-site`)

parts.description: Build and deploy Power Apps generative pages (genux) for model-driven apps. React 17 + TypeScript + Fluent UI v9 single-file components.
parts.downstream_target: Model-driven Power App (deployed via `pac model genpage`)

parts.description: Generate MCP App widgets — self-contained HTML using the MCP Apps protocol. Loads dependencies from CDN, no build step.
parts.downstream_target: MCP Apps host (Claude, ChatGPT, VS Code, Microsoft 365 Copilot) — host loads the HTML directly

parts.description: Author Power Apps Canvas Apps via the Canvas Authoring MCP server. Generates .pa.yaml files in coordination with a live coauthoring session.
parts.downstream_target: Canvas App (compile_canvas + sync_canvas against live coauthoring session)
parts.auth: Inherits browser coauthoring session — requires Power Apps Studio tab to stay open

parts.description: Build and deploy Power Apps code apps using React + Vite + TypeScript with Power Platform connectors. Sandboxed runtime — all data access must go through connectors.
parts.downstream_target: Power Apps code app (deployed via `npx power-apps push`)
parts.notes: Marketplace name differs from source dir: `code-apps-preview` ↔ `plugins/code-apps`. Preserve this mapping.

proposed_parts.notes: PROPOSAL.md only — not registered in marketplace.json. Planned authoring surface: Dataverse Web API (/workflows). Packaging: pac solution clone/pack.

integration_points.details: Per-plugin SKILL.md contains frontmatter + one-line reference back to the shared workflow file
Skills delegate specialized work to sub-agents via the Task tool
Auto-mounted when plugin enabled; tools surfaced as mcp__<server>__<tool>
Skill matcher → run-skill-posttool-validation.js → skill name → validator script
Authenticated via az login → getAuthToken (power-pages) or pac auth (other plugins)
